name: nexus-phase4-retrieval-foundation
description: Synthetic deterministic corpus for software capability selection. It is not an external or model-quality benchmark.

capabilities.name: release-notes
capabilities.description: Prepare concise changelogs and release summaries from verified changes.

capabilities.name: security-review
capabilities.description: Inspect source changes for vulnerabilities, unsafe flows, and policy violations.

capabilities.name: incident-response
capabilities.description: Triage service failures and prepare bounded incident recovery actions.

capabilities.name: api-documentation
capabilities.description: Document typed HTTP interfaces, request schemas, and response contracts.

capabilities.name: dependency-audit
capabilities.description: Review dependency manifests, provenance, licenses, and vulnerability evidence.

capabilities.name: test-planning
capabilities.description: Design deterministic normal, boundary, failure, and regression test cases.

cases.query: summarize verified changes for a new version
find unsafe flows and policy violations in this change
triage a service failure and plan recovery
describe request and response schemas for an HTTP interface
inspect package provenance licenses and advisories
design boundary failure and regression cases
